mostWorthwhile.text: Following the surviving pillar clumps into a new dense knot was most worthwhile: it connected erosion with a fresh gathering.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial tail-gas combination felt least consequential on its own; it set up the region without resolving a goal.

surprise.text: The nursery outflow mixed with gas from the earlier galactic crossing, giving the resulting stream more than one origin.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly purposeless, though the offered combinations guided my choices rather than requiring me to discover compatibility.

continue.text: Yes. I'd be curious to follow the dense knot and dispersed gas further, especially after their separate histories came together.
